messages.subject: unbindAll bindAll pattern broken in 0.12
parts:
This is probably related to discussion in https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shiny-discuss/czXoYWnXGe8/CjO_S5swG2kJ, but the focus was different so I'll start a new more general thread.

It seems, that the unbindAll(), do something, bindAll() pattern have been broken in the latest version of Shiny - based on the response in the aforementioned discussion it seems unintentional.

Minimal example that consistently works on my Mac in both Safari and Chrome:

ui <- shinyUI(fluidPage(

  mainPanel(

    verbatimTextOutput('test')

  )

))


server <- shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

  output$test <- renderPrint({input$test})

  observe({

    print(input$test)

  })

})


runApp(list(ui=ui, server=server))


In the Shiny app open developers tools in Chrome and type:


Shiny.onInputChange('test', 'testing 1, 2, 3')


you should see the text change accordingly on the webpage.


Now type this:


Shiny.unbindAll()

Shiny.bindAll()

Shiny.onInputChange('test', 'testing 1, 2, 3')


for me at least nothing happens, but you can see that the message is reaching the server, so it is apparent that it is a problem with the outputs...


I do hope for a quick fix on this, as my shinyFiles package is currently non-functional (but not throwing any errors) because of it...


best


Thomas

messages.subject: Re: unbindAll bindAll pattern broken in 0.12
parts:
Thanks for the report and especially the super helpful repro case.

Issue here: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/856
Pull request here: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/pull/857

You can install by running: devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny@joe/bugfix/rebind")

The other two developers on the Shiny team are coincidentally both out this week, so I'd definitely appreciate it if you could install the branch and let me know if it works for you. Once I get confirmation that it fixes the problem I'll merge it to master.

Thanks!
